reason: V1 action-history cue failed the pretraining current-query context probe at 0.6667 versus the preregistered 0.60 ceiling.
claim_boundary: Development stage gate for action-to-RGB simulator coupling. It is not a sealed test, translated navigation, pixel generation, or free rollout.

task.episode: one continuous simulator instance; randomized A-B-A or B-A-B
task.context_history: 10 post-action RGB frames containing a hash-disjoint, randomly relabeled sequence of two visible landmarks and hidden noops
task.cue_to_context_mapping: random within each environment; the return sequence repeats the first history, so no landmark color has a global A/B meaning
task.shared_view_sweep: identical 20-left-action full rotation for both contexts, with four view-places
task.return_anchor: the first return view exposes one previously stored target but is not written
task.headline_queries: three delayed neutral queries after the return anchor
task.content_remapping: three delayed view-places use different target identities across contexts; the anchor-adjacent view is a clean control

paired_counterfactual_contract.purpose: prove the current query frame cannot reveal context; only earlier visual history differs

simulator_contract.world_reconfiguration: target geoms are presented at cue/write/anchor steps and reduced to non-visible size at neutral/query steps
simulator_contract.pose_use: generator QA and figure metadata only; never a model input

model_inputs: frozen DINOv2 spatial broad-ROI pooled feature from the corresponding simulator RGB frame

memory_contract.architecture: Window Transformer PFC plus action-only periodic EC, frozen sparse place population, latent context, and one episode-local factorized covariance HPC
memory_contract.query_targets: DINO features copied from strictly earlier visible write frames

vision_contract.feature: last normalized spatial patch map pooled over the fixed middle/lower broad ROI
vision_contract.visualization: nearest earlier write RGB under recalled DINO feature; never labeled as generated pixels

split_policy.sealed_test_policy: Do not generate or inspect before the development gate is accepted.

stop_rules: If paired current query RGB is not pixel-identical, stop before DINO encoding.
If any simulator or leakage gate fails, stop before training.
If single-seed mechanism interventions fail, do not expand seeds.
Do not call this translated navigation or free rollout.

amendments.decision: No V1 training. Replace action-history cue with randomized visual-history cue and exact paired counterfactual current-query RGB.

amendments.observed_core_result: All causal mechanism gates passed, but conflict target cosine was 0.1874 while pairwise accuracy was 1.0.
amendments.decision: Keep the same model, data, and one content objective; add weight 1.0 on conflict target cosine and require at least 0.85 so the result is faithful feature recall rather than ranking alone.
